newsitem.title: USA: USTR's Shapiro to join Washington law firm.
newsitem.headline: USTR's Shapiro to join Washington law firm.

text.p: Senior U.S. trade negotiator Ira Shapiro will become a partner at Collier, Shannon, Rill & Scott, the Washington law firm said Monday.

Shapiro, who was an important figure in trade talks with Japan, Canada and Mexico, said earlier this year that he intended to leave the government after more than four years with the United States Trade Representative's office.
Shapiro first served as general counsel to U.S. Trade Representative Mickey Kantor and beginning in 1995 was chief trade negotiator with Japan and Canada.
Collier, Shannon, Rill & Scott said it had more than 100 attorneys practicing in areas including antitrust and trade regulation, intellectual property and international trade.
